project_name: Object Retrieval in Dynamic Workspace Environments — Browser Demonstrator

frontend_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS + Custom CSS Variables (App.css dark theme)

models.runtime: ONNX Runtime Web 1.31.1 via Web Worker (reactpp.worker.ts)
models.purpose: Primary Scene Graph Generation (SGG): simultaneous object detection and spatial relationship prediction.
models.loading_behaviour: Eager on application startup / Standby in Web Worker

input_format.image: RGBA Canvas Blob scaled to max 512x512

output_format.structure: JSON: { found, entity_label, description, confidence, candidate_relations }

models.purpose: Conditional Visual Language Model (VLM) fallback for out-of-vocabulary objects, attributes (color/material/state), and explicit user /visual queries.
models.loading_behaviour: Lazy-loaded on first fallback invocation with persistent Cache API ('smolvlm-execu-v1')
models.memory_use: Estimated ~680 MB GPU VRAM / Shared Buffer

features.description: Single-pass forward inference generating 2D object bounding boxes and directed relationship triplets.
Canvas letterboxing with aspect-ratio preservation and inverse coordinate un-padding back to native observation pixels.
Maps 133 OpenPSG classes into 39 workspace classes and 57 OpenPSG predicates into 6 canonical predicates with unmapped tagging.
Supports sequential image appending, batch image uploads, per-frame deletion, and selective frame activation.
Renders 1-col (single frame), 2-col (side-by-side comparative), or 3+-col grid with coordinate-isolated SVG viewports.
Visual hierarchy with 3 attention levels (Level 1 focus, Level 2 connected neighbors, Level 3 dimmed background) across 4 viewing modes.
Dense object cards displaying color chips, confidence score, instance ID tag, category tag, and expandable BBox accordion.
Lists subject-predicate-object triplets with confidence badges, source attribution ('sgg' vs 'vlm'), and multi-frame attribution.
10 relational object stores persisting workspaces, sequences, frames, object instances, observations, relationships, events, and queries.
IoU (>0.30) and normalized center-distance (<0.45) tracking linking detections across frames into persistent physical instances.
Detects displaced objects (>0.08 normalized shift), newly appeared objects, and disappeared objects across selected observations.
Extracts query intent, target mention, reference mention, attributes, time scope, and disambiguation criteria.
Executes 8 distinct query intents against active scene graphs, historical memory, and comparative frame selections.
Displays verified provenance ('Confirmed stored information' vs 'Provisional inference'), frame provenance, and follow-up chips.
Generates interactive selection cards when multiple candidates match a query, allowing single-click disambiguation.
Clicking 'View Frame' in assistant messages switches to the source frame, locks the object selection, and scrolls into view.
Routes unknown objects, visual attributes (color/material/state), or explicit '/visual' queries to SmolVLM-500M.
Decouples VLM from spatial coordinates (targetBbox = null), preventing hallucinated coordinates from corrupting SGG vectors.
Live bottom drawer reporting SGG latency, VLM status, execution provider, object memory counts, and system capabilities.
26 automated unit and acceptance tests covering vocabulary, postprocessing, storage, tracking, parsing, and multi-frame reasoning.
Serialization and deserialization of complete IndexedDB workspace memory graphs.
Re-inferring only changed bounding box patches rather than full 640x640 frame re-inference.
Fine-tuned REACT++ head trained on custom indoor workspace datasets.

known_limitations.impact: Office objects outside OpenPSG (e.g. power adapters, staplers, badges) appear under surrogate classes or as unmapped entities (det_X_Y).
All spatial bounding boxes and displacement metrics are 2D pixel-based rather than true 3D metric coordinates.
Every added observation runs full 640x640 neural inference rather than incremental change-detection patches.
Devices without WebGPU support fall back to WASM SIMD, where VLM reasoning incurs 4-5 second execution latency.
